practicalCriteria: Every one of the 19 fields is completed, or marked not applicable with a reason in the field
Each revenue target equals jobs multiplied by average job value, and each assumption has a check date
Each customer segment names the decision maker, the service bought and the purchase frequency
Every statement in the executive summary traces to a section of the plan
Each risk row names a specific response and an owner, and each legal, tax or registration statement is sourced
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: not applicable: document-only lesson, no field work
